name: gmsm-streaming-pkcs-encryption-and-container-07f4
instr:
gmsm cannot currently encrypt or decrypt registered AES, DES, and SM4 ciphers with bounded memory. Add streaming support through CMS, PKCS#8, and CFCA operations. Streamed and one-shot representations must remain mutually readable without weakening authentication or container semantics.

Cipher streams must round-trip arbitrary write boundaries, promptly emit complete non-final CBC blocks, apply CBC and ECB padding exactly once, and disclose GCM plaintext only after authentication succeeds. Cancellation remains the error returned by later writes and close. Destination, truncation, padding, and authentication failures must be stable, never finalize successfully, and never expose invalid partial output.

CMS decryption must write primitive or constructed encrypted content incrementally while enforcing the selected cipher's final authentication boundary. Preserve recipients, versions, content identifiers, cipher parameters, PSK behavior, and signed-and-enveloped verification. Constructed CMS GCM content reaches its destination only after the final tag succeeds. A downstream write failure must prevent a CMS producer from returning a parseable completed container. Streaming AES-CBC CMS output must remain consumable by existing one-shot decryption.

PKCS#8 streaming must preserve password defaults, plaintext handling, typed results, and existing malformed or unsupported-container error classifications. Authenticate streamed AES-GCM output before private-key parsing. CFCA streaming
